name: BACH_0161_FSIM_stain3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (98%)** · Confident · Careful review
The conformal set holds InSitu only, but the MUSK second model picks a different class [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 98%, Invasive 2% | Strongly favors InSitu |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.97 / 64th percentile | Input looks typical |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Different top class |
| Similar cases | 4 of 5 InSitu | Mostly supportive [F5] |

## Tissue evidence
- **Atypical cells confined in ducts** (regions 4, 5, 6) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; fits in situ pattern [F3] · Weak
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 3, 6) · ↑ invasive · High score, but failed spot check (3/20) · Unreliable
- **Nuclear pleomorphism** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Near typical; one region stands out · Validated
- **Lymphocytic infiltrate** (region 6) · context · Below typical; not used as a reason [F2] · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions beats random removal (logit drop 0.54, CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so unproven; necrosis (3/20) is Unreliable here.

## Could be wrong if
- MUSK disagrees, and neighbor BACH_0138 (Invasive, similarity 0.89) is close.
- Simulated stain degradation (severity 3) distorts embeddings despite high reliability.

## Check on the slide
1. **4, 5, 6**: Confirm atypical cells stay inside ducts; look for stromal breach.
2. **7**: Highest pleomorphism and stromal-invasion scores; look for invasive foci.
3. **3**: Necrosis hotspot at the corner of both involved margins; verify margin call [F7].
